name: The Westin Mission Hills Resort & Spa
insider_take: Nestled against the Santa Rosa Mountains in the sun-drenched Coachella Valley, The Westin Mission Hills Resort & Spa is a desert oasis where PGA-caliber golf meets world-class wellness — all just minutes from the glamour of Palm Springs.
whats_special: Home to two championship golf courses — one designed by Pete Dye and another by Gary Player — making it a bucket-list destination for golf enthusiasts. The resort's expansive Heavenly Spa by Westin draws on desert healing traditions, offering treatments inspired by the natural surroundings of the Sonoran Desert. Set within Rancho Mirage, famously known as the "Playground of the Presidents," having hosted luminaries from Frank Sinatra to multiple U.S. presidents. Part of the Marriott Luminous collection, recognizing it as a resort with distinctive character and elevated experiences above standard branded properties.
pro_tip: Book a casita-style room facing the golf course for stunning Santa Rosa Mountain sunrise views — and ask about early tee-time packages to beat the desert heat on the fairways.
dont_miss: The resort's stunning free-form pool complex — one of the largest in the Palm Springs area — perfect for a lazy afternoon under the desert sun. A short drive to El Paseo in Palm Desert, the "Rodeo Drive of the Desert," for world-class shopping and dining. The nearby Living Desert Zoo and Gardens, a unique wildlife and botanical park showcasing the flora and fauna of the world's deserts.
pros: Championship golf courses on-site with stunning desert mountain views
Full-service spa offering signature treatments and wellness programs
Prime Rancho Mirage location near upscale shopping and dining
Multiple pools and recreational facilities for all ages
cons: Resort fees and premium pricing for amenities
Large property requiring walking between facilities
